full.body:
Historical source status

The corresponding historical Google Sites page publishes no body text. In the current Meronic Model, stellar cores are described as solid Merons with an indefinite Structural Number; they share the cuboctahedral Alpha-Point architecture of the vacuum and differ through geometric density and distance.
